about.title: ABOUT TAHER
about.lead: I don't hand over drawings. I hand over keys.
paragraphs: Every space begins as a conversation and ends as a place you live in. In between are a thousand quiet decisions — about light, proportion, material, and the way a door feels when it closes.

I make those decisions twice: once on paper, and again on site. The same mind that draws the line is the one standing beside it while it's built — so nothing gets lost between the idea and the finished room.
Villas, homes, interiors, commercial spaces — carried from first sketch to final handover. One vision. One responsibility. No compromises in between.

services.title: Architectural Design
services.description: Concept, massing and full working drawings — buildings shaped around light, proportion and the way you actually live.

services.title: Interior Design
services.description: Considered interiors where layout, materials, lighting and joinery are resolved as one composed experience.

services.title: Luxury Finishing
services.description: Natural stone, bespoke joinery, concealed details and premium systems — finished to a standard you can feel.

services.title: Construction & Execution
services.description: Structure to finish, delivered with disciplined planning, vetted crews and uncompromising quality control.

services.title: Site Management
services.description: Daily supervision, scheduling, procurement and reporting — so the drawings are built exactly as intended.

services.title: Turnkey Projects
services.description: A single contract from first concept to the day you receive the keys. One vision, one responsibility.

projects.title: Gardenia Park
projects.description: A grand classic interior brought to life on site — Corinthian columns, hand-detailed gypsum mouldings and a sculpted dome ceiling, a sweeping bookmatched-marble staircase with wrought-iron balustrades, and warm concealed lighting tracing every line.

projects.title: Palm Villa
projects.description: Full execution and finishing of a contemporary villa — a timber-slatted pergola over a solid-wood entrance, granite steps with frameless glass balustrades, and marble interiors with wood wall cladding and feature ceilings.

projects.title: Residence Interior Concept
projects.description: A bold residential interior: sculpted velvet seating, blush glass pendants and classic wall mouldings in the living room, paired with a playful, custom-joinery bedroom and study.

philosophy.headline: DESIGN IS ONLY THE BEGINNING.
philosophy.textAr: التصميم الجيد لا يكتمل إلا عندما يتحول إلى تنفيذ دقيق يحافظ على الفكرة والتفاصيل والجودة.
ordinary: Drawings handed over, then you're on your own
ours: The designer stays on site until handover
Design intent protected in every decision
Every detail drawn — and built — as drawn
One vision. One management. One responsibility.

process.title: Consultation
process.description: We meet, visit the site and understand how you live, your ambitions, timeline and budget.

process.title: Concept Design
process.description: Spatial concept, mood and material direction — presented with 3D visuals for clear decisions.

process.title: Technical Drawings
process.description: Complete working drawings, details, BOQ and a transparent cost and time plan.

process.title: Execution
process.description: Vetted crews, scheduled procurement and daily site supervision against the drawings.

process.title: Quality Control
process.description: Staged inspections and snag lists at every milestone — nothing is covered until it's right.

process.title: Handover
process.description: A finished, clean, fully tested space — delivered with documentation and aftercare.

why.title: One Point of Responsibility
why.description: The person who designs your project is the person accountable for building it. No gaps, no blame-shifting.

why.title: Design Intent, Protected
why.description: Every on-site decision is made by someone who understands why the design was drawn that way.

why.title: Obsessive Detailing
why.description: Joints, reveals, junctions and light — the details that separate luxury from merely expensive.

why.title: Transparent Budgets
why.description: Clear BOQs, honest timelines and regular reporting, so you always know where your project stands.

why.title: Trusted Crews & Suppliers
why.description: A tested network of craftsmen and material suppliers held to the same standard on every job.

why.title: Delivered, Not Just Drawn
why.description: Success is measured on handover day — a finished space that matches the vision you signed off.
